description: Source code for a plugin module 'mod_vhostdb_pgsql' that integrates PostgreSQL database lookups for virtual host mapping in the lighttpd web server. It includes functions for setup, cleanup, configuration merging, and querying the database.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbconf_free
methods.description: Frees the database connection configuration, closing the PostgreSQL connection and freeing memory.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_dbconf_setup
methods.description: Sets up the database connection configuration by reading options, establishing a PostgreSQL connection, and validating the connection.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_pgsql_query
methods.description: Executes a SQL query against PostgreSQL to retrieve the virtual host mapping and stores the result in the provided buffer.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_init
methods.description: Initializes the plugin, registers the PostgreSQL backend for virtual host lookups.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up plugin resources, freeing database configurations.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_merge_config_cpv
methods.description: Merges a configuration plugin value into the plugin's configuration.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_merge_config
methods.description: Merges multiple configuration plugin values into the plugin's configuration.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_patch_config
methods.description: Applies configuration settings to a request based on current plugin configuration and conditions.

methods.name: mod_vhostdb_set_defaults
methods.description: Sets default configuration values for the plugin, including reading configuration directives.
